blocks.text: The Zscaler and Cradlepoint Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) with the Cradlepoint platform.

ZIA is a cloud-based solution providing a secure web gateway for business networks and users. Zscaler's high availability and robust policy specifications, along with Cradlepoint’s Elastic Edge and NetCloud Manager platform, provide a comprehensive, easily deployable, and centrally managed security solution.
